title: Remove 'Built with using caffeine.ai' footer from all pages

requirements.text: Remove the 'Built with using caffeine.ai' footer text from all pages. Search all frontend layout and page components (including AppLayout.tsx, LoginPage.tsx, and any other page-level files) for any element rendering this text and delete it entirely. No footer attribution should appear anywhere in the application.

quotes: in bottom of all pages it shows "Built with using caffeine.ai" remove that from all pages

acceptanceCriteria: No page in the application displays the text 'Built with using caffeine.ai' or any variation of it.
The footer element or container that held this text is also removed if it served no other purpose.
All pages — including the login page, dashboard, hospital finder, blood donor, volunteer, resource map, emergency contacts, and any other routes — are free of this attribution text.
No other visible content or layout is affected by the removal.

constraints: Do not modify any files listed under frontend.immutablePaths.
Do not alter any other UI content, layout, or styling beyond removing the attribution footer text.
nonGoals: Changing any other part of the application UI or functionality.
